newsitem.title: USA: Baxter application approved for review.
newsitem.headline: Baxter application approved for review.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has accepted its application to review a system which is used in autologous cell transplants following chemotherapy.
Baxter's application seeks marketing approval from the FDA for its Isolex 300 magnetic cell separator system.

Patients receiving high dose chemotherapy for cancer treatment require stem cell transplants to regenerate blood and immune cells which have been damaged or destroyed by the chemotherapy. The Isolex stems were approved for sale throughout Europe in January 1995.
